newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy parliament looks at final sections of budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy parliament looks at final sections of budget.

text.p: The lower house of parliament on Friday started work on ratifying the final two sections of the budget law after approving the core of the package in the early hours of the day.
The budget law is divided into three sections:
-- The so-called connected draft law, which was ratified on Friday and contains all the key budget measures.
-- The finanziaria, which contains the overall spending plans for the various state bodies.
-- The state budget, which outlines the budgets for each of the various government ministries.
Parliamentary officials said the house approved the first six articles of the state budget on Friday morning. Once this section has been approved, the house will examine the finanziaria.
Voting on both sections should be concluded by Sunday after which the draft law goes to the Senate (upper house) for ratification. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
